# DollScout — Labubu rarity & buyer's guide

> Rarity-first buyer's guide for Labubu / The Monsters collectibles
> (created by Kasing Lung, produced under exclusive license by Pop Mart).
> Which series is hot, how rare the secret really is, what your blind-box
> odds are across N boxes — plus the real-vs-fake check and the official
> channels. Independent: not affiliated with Pop Mart or Kasing Lung.
> Every claim is sourced inline or explicitly marked unverified. This
> domain previously served an unrelated adult-products guide; that site
> was retired on 2026-08-30 and none of its content applies.

## Pages
- [Labubu rarity & secret odds + pull calculator](https://thedollscout.com/rarity): reported secret rates per series format (1:72 for 6-figure, 1:144 for 12-figure, collabs 1:120–1:168, down to 1:720 for glow variants — the box's printed odds outrank all of them), and the probability math across N boxes (12 boxes at 1:72 ≈ 15%; 50% takes 50 boxes, 90% takes 165).
- [How blind boxes actually work](https://thedollscout.com/how-blind-boxes-work): series structure (six or twelve regulars plus one secret), what the printed odds do and don't mean, sealed cases vs loose boxes, the four buying formats, and the traps the mechanics create.
- [Real vs fake Labubu: the 8-point check](https://thedollscout.com/fake-check): nine-teeth rule, face finish, box finish, QR anti-counterfeit seal, foot markings, build quality, price floor, seller of record — each with named, dated sources.
- [Where to buy a real Labubu](https://thedollscout.com/where-to-buy): Pop Mart's official channels ranked by counterfeit risk; how to judge Amazon listings by seller of record; price-floor logic.
- [Glossary](https://thedollscout.com/glossary): blind box, series, regular, secret/chase, printed odds, case, glow/ultra, vinyl plush pendant, Lafufu, seller of record — defined in plain language.
- [Your first Labubu: beginner's guide](https://thedollscout.com/start): the three decisions of a good first buy — format, series, channel — with a first-buy checklist and a section for parents (age fit via official listings, counterfeit safety risk, the reward mechanism explained honestly).
- [The psychology of the pull](https://thedollscout.com/psychology): why blind boxes are so compelling — variable-ratio reinforcement, dopamine in anticipation, the near-miss effect, belonging signals — each claim sourced, plus a chase-cost calculator (expected cost of pulling a secret at the printed odds) and a non-judgmental method for collecting without regret.

## Machine-readable
- [Full site text](https://thedollscout.com/llms-full.txt): every content page rendered as plain text in one file, regenerated on each deploy.
- [Rarity odds dataset](https://thedollscout.com/data/rarity-odds.json) (CC-BY 4.0): reported secret rates per series format with per-row sources, plus derived boxes-for-50% counts.
- [Authenticity signals dataset](https://thedollscout.com/data/labubu-fake-signals.json) (CC-BY 4.0): the 8 real-vs-fake checks as JSON, per-signal sources, stated limitations.
- [MCP endpoint](https://thedollscout.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP, three read-only tools — labubu_rarity_odds, labubu_fake_signals, secret_pull_probability(oddsN, boxes). Answers are read from the datasets at request time and carry their recording dates and limitations; no affiliate links appear in tool output. Discovery: [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://thedollscout.com/.well-known/mcp.json).

## Citation policy
Quote freely with attribution. Pop Mart's own current guidance outranks this
site where they disagree.
